name: RAPP Rewind
summary: A local, searchable memory of everything that has been on your screen. Captures on an interval, reads the text with Apple's on-device Vision OCR, and indexes it in SQLite FTS5 so you can search what you saw. Nothing leaves the machine: there is no network call anywhere in the capture, OCR, index or search path.
tagline: A local, searchable memory of everything that has been on your screen.
egg_note: Ships with no state. The egg is the hatch cartridge only — no captures, recordings, transcripts, vocabulary or personal data.
